rows.question: Please generate a summary of the closing balances at the end of each month for each customer transactions, show the monthly changes and monthly cumulative bank account balances. Ensure that even if a customer has no account activity in a given month, the balance for that month is still included in the output.

WITH customer_monthly_agg AS (
SELECT
  ct.customer_id AS customer_id,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS calendar_year,
  CAST(strftime('%m', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS month_number,
  date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', ct.txn_date)) AS month_start_date,
  date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', ct.txn_date), '+1 month', '-1 day') AS month_end_date,
  SUM(ct.txn_amount) AS monthly_txn_sum,
  COUNT(*) AS monthly_txn_count
FROM customer_transactions AS ct
GROUP BY
  ct.customer_id,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER),
  CAST(strftime('%m', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER)
),
monthly_customer_txn_aggregates AS (
SELECT
  customer_id,
  printf('%04d-%02d', calendar_year, month_number) AS month,
  month_start_date,
  month_end_date,
  monthly_txn_count AS transactions_in_month,
  monthly_txn_sum AS sum_txn_amount_in_month
FROM customer_monthly_agg
),
customer_monthly_closing_balance_base AS (
SELECT
  ct.customer_id AS customer_id,
  printf('%04d-%02d', ct.calendar_year, ct.month_number) AS month,
  ct.month_start_date AS month_start_date,
  ct.month_end_date AS month_end_date,
  COALESCE(ct.monthly_txn_sum, 0) AS sum_txn_amount_in_month,
  (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ct2.monthly_txn_sum), 0)
    FROM customer_monthly_agg ct2
    WHERE ct2.customer_id = ct.customer_id
      AND (ct2.calendar_year < ct.calendar_year
           OR (ct2.calendar_year = ct.calendar_year AND ct2.month_number <= ct.month_number))
  ) AS running_sum_txn_up_to_month
FROM customer_monthly_agg ct
)
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  m.month,
  m.month || '-01' AS month_start_date,
  date(m.month || '-01', '+' || (strftime('%d', date(m.month || '-01', '+1 month', '-1 day'))) || ' days') AS month_end_date,
  closing.closing_balance AS closing_balance,
  CASE
    WHEN LAG(closing.closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY m.month) IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE closing.closing_balance - LAG(closing.closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY m.month)
  END AS monthly_change,
  closing.closing_balance AS cumulative_balance,
  COALESCE(a.transactions_in_month, 0) AS transactions_in_month,
  COALESCE(a.sum_txn_amount_in_month, 0) AS sum_txn_amount_in_month
FROM
  (
    -- distinct customers
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
  ) c
CROSS JOIN
  (
    -- global month range generated from customer_transactions
    WITH bounds AS (
      SELECT min(substr(txn_date,1,7)) AS min_month, max(substr(txn_date,1,7)) AS max_month FROM customer_transactions
    ),
    nums AS (
      SELECT 0 AS n
      UNION ALL
      SELECT n+1 FROM nums, bounds
      WHERE date(bounds.min_month || '-01', '+' || (n+1) || ' months') <= date(bounds.max_month || '-01')
    )
    SELECT
      substr(date(bounds.min_month || '-01', '+' || n || ' months'), 1, 7) AS month
    FROM nums, bounds
    ORDER BY month
  ) m
LEFT JOIN monthly_customer_txn_aggregates a
  ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  AND a.month = m.month
-- compute closing balance by cumulative sum of monthly sums over the full month grid per customer
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    month,
    SUM(coalesce(sum_txn_amount_in_month, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS closing_balance
  FROM (
    -- grid of customers x months with txn sums (zero when missing)
    SELECT
      c2.customer_id,
      m2.month,
      COALESCE(a2.sum_txn_amount_in_month, 0) AS sum_txn_amount_in_month
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions) c2
    CROSS JOIN (
      WITH bounds AS (
        SELECT min(substr(txn_date,1,7)) AS min_month, max(substr(txn_date,1,7)) AS max_month FROM customer_transactions
      ),
      nums AS (
        SELECT 0 AS n
        UNION ALL
        SELECT n+1 FROM nums, bounds
        WHERE date(bounds.min_month || '-01', '+' || (n+1) || ' months') <= date(bounds.max_month || '-01')
      )
      SELECT substr(date(bounds.min_month || '-01', '+' || n || ' months'), 1, 7) AS month
      FROM nums, bounds
    ) m2
    LEFT JOIN monthly_customer_txn_aggregates a2
      ON a2.customer_id = c2.customer_id
      AND a2.month = m2.month
    ORDER BY c2.customer_id, m2.month
  )
) closing
  ON closing.customer_id = c.customer_id
  AND closing.month = m.month
ORDER BY c.customer_id ASC, m.month ASC

    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    txn_type,
    txn_amount
  FROM customer_transactions

    ct.customer_id AS customer_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS txn_year,
    CAST(strftime('%m', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS txn_month,
    (strftime('%Y', ct.txn_date) || '-' || strftime('%m', ct.txn_date)) AS month_label,

    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) = 'withdrawal' THEN ct.txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sum_withdrawals,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount
             WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) = 'withdrawal' THEN -ct.txn_amount

          SELECT 2020,2,'2020-02' UNION ALL

rows.question: For each customer, group all deposits and withdrawals by the first day of each month to obtain a monthly net amount, then calculate each month’s closing balance by cumulatively summing these monthly nets. Next, determine the most recent month’s growth rate by comparing its closing balance to the prior month’s balance, treating deposits as positive and withdrawals as negative, and if the previous month’s balance is zero, the growth rate should be the current month’s balance multiplied by 100. Finally, compute the percentage of customers whose most recent month shows a growth rate of more than 5%.

WITH customer_transaction_monthly_net AS (
SELECT
  ct.customer_id AS customer_id,
  -- represent month by its first day (YYYY-MM-01)
  substr(ct.txn_date, 1, 7) || '-01' AS month_start,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount
      ELSE -ct.txn_amount
    END
  ) AS monthly_net
FROM customer_transactions AS ct
GROUP BY
  ct.customer_id,
  month_start
),
customer_monthly_closing_balance_60 AS (
SELECT
  ct.customer_id AS customer_id,
  date(substr(ct.txn_date,1,4) || '-' || printf('%02d', CAST(strftime('%m', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER)) || '-01') AS month_start,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) IN ('deposit','credit','cr') THEN ct.txn_amount
      WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) IN ('withdrawal','debit','wd') THEN -ct.txn_amount
      ELSE ct.txn_amount
    END
  ) AS monthly_net,
  SUM(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) IN ('deposit','credit','cr') THEN ct.txn_amount
        WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) IN ('withdrawal','debit','wd') THEN -ct.txn_amount
        ELSE ct.txn_amount
      END
    )
  ) OVER (PARTITION BY ct.customer_id ORDER BY date(substr(ct.txn_date,1,4) || '-' || printf('%02d', CAST(strftime('%m', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER)) || '-01') ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS closing_balance
FROM customer_transactions AS ct
GROUP BY ct.customer_id, month_start
),
customer_most_recent_and_prior_months AS (
SELECT
  cmc.customer_id,
  cmc.month_start AS most_recent_month_start,
  cmc.closing_balance AS recent_closing_balance,
  cmc.prior_month_start AS prior_month_start,
  cmc.prior_closing_balance AS prior_closing_balance
FROM (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    closing_balance,
    LAG(month_start) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS prior_month_start,
    LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS prior_closing_balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC) AS rn
  FROM customer_monthly_closing_balance_60
) cmc
WHERE cmc.rn = 1
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_customers_evaluated,
  SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS customers_with_growth_gt_5pct,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0.0
       ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*)
  END AS percent_customers_with_growth_gt_5pct
FROM (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    most_recent_month_start,
    recent_closing_balance,
    prior_month_start,
    prior_closing_balance,
    CASE
      WHEN recent_closing_balance IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN prior_closing_balance IS NULL AND prior_month_start IS NULL THEN recent_closing_balance * 100.0
      WHEN prior_closing_balance = 0 THEN recent_closing_balance * 100.0
      ELSE (recent_closing_balance - prior_closing_balance) * 1.0 / prior_closing_balance
    END AS growth_rate
  FROM customer_most_recent_and_prior_months
  -- include customers with a most recent month and either a prior month or handled by prior-zero rule
  WHERE most_recent_month_start IS NOT NULL
    AND (prior_month_start IS NOT NULL OR prior_closing_balance = 0 OR prior_closing_balance IS NULL)
) sub
WHERE growth_rate IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  ct.customer_id AS customer_id,
  -- canonical month start in format YYYY-MM-01 based on txn_date (assumes txn_date stored as YYYY-MM-DD or compatible)
  substr(ct.txn_date,1,4) || '-' || printf('%02d', CAST(strftime('%m', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER)) || '-01' AS month_start_date,
  -- cumulative balance using transactions strictly before the month_start_date
  (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ct2.txn_amount), 0)
    FROM customer_transactions ct2
    WHERE ct2.customer_id = ct.customer_id
      AND date(ct2.txn_date) < date(substr(ct.txn_date,1,4) || '-' || printf('%02d', CAST(strftime('%m', ct.txn_date) AS INTEGER)) || '-01')
  ) AS cumulative_balance
FROM customer_transactions ct
),
customer_transaction_rows AS (
SELECT
  customer_id,
  -- normalize txn_date to ISO YYYY-MM-DD if possible; assume input like '2020-01-21' or '21/01/2020' or '2020-01-21 00:00:00'
  CASE
    WHEN length(txn_date) = 10 AND substr(txn_date,5,1) = '-' THEN txn_date
    WHEN instr(txn_date,'/') > 0 THEN
      -- handle DD/MM/YYYY or D/M/YY forms by splitting on '/'
      ( 
        -- extract parts
        substr(txn_date, (case when length(txn_date) >= 8 then 1 else 1 end), instr(txn_date,'/')-1)
      ) -- placeholder to satisfy SQLite parser; real normalization below

  CASE
    WHEN substr(txn_date,1,7) = (
      SELECT substr(min(txn_date),1,7) FROM customer_transactions
    ) THEN 1

FROM customer_transactions
GROUP BY month_start_date
)

rows.question: For a bank database with customer transactions, calculate each customer's daily running balance (where deposits add to the balance and other transaction types subtract). For each customer and each day, compute the 30-day rolling average balance (only after having 30 days of data, and treating negative averages as zero). Then group these daily averages by month and find each customer's maximum 30-day average balance within each month. Sum these maximum values across all customers for each month. Consider the first month of each customer's transaction history as the baseline period and exclude it from the final results, presenting monthly totals of these summed maximum 30-day average balances.

SELECT
  customer_id AS customer_id,
  txn_date AS txn_date,
  txn_type AS txn_type,
  txn_amount AS txn_amount
FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_daily_eod_balance_66 AS (
SELECT
  ct.customer_id AS customer_id,
  ct.txn_date AS txn_date,
  SUM(ct.txn_amount) OVER (
    PARTITION BY ct.customer_id
    ORDER BY DATE(ct.txn_date)
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS end_of_day_balance
FROM customer_transactions AS ct
),
customer_daily_net_change AS (
SELECT
  customer_id,
  date(substr(txn_date, 1, 10)) AS date,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
      ELSE -txn_amount
    END
  ) AS daily_net_change
FROM customer_transactions
GROUP BY customer_id, date(substr(txn_date, 1, 10))
),
customer_daily_net_amounts AS (
SELECT
  ct.customer_id AS customer_id,
  ct.txn_date AS txn_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN lower(ct.txn_type) = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount ELSE -ct.txn_amount END) AS net_amount
FROM customer_transactions AS ct
GROUP BY ct.customer_id, ct.txn_date
),
customer_daily_eod_balance AS (
SELECT
  d.customer_id,
  d.date,
  -- running end-of-day balance: cumulative sum of daily_net_change per customer ordered by date
  (SELECT SUM(d2.daily_net_change)
   FROM customer_daily_net_change d2
   WHERE d2.customer_id = d.customer_id
     AND date(d2.date) <= date(d.date)
  ) AS end_of_day_balance,
  -- flag if the date is in the same month as the customer's first transaction month
  (CASE
     WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', d.date) = strftime('%Y-%m', (
         SELECT MIN(date) FROM customer_daily_net_change d3 WHERE d3.customer_id = d.customer_id
     )) THEN 1 ELSE 0
   END) AS is_first_txn_month
FROM customer_daily_net_change d
),

SELECT
  d.customer_id AS customer_id,
  d.date       AS txn_date,
  AVG(e.end_of_day_balance) AS rolling_30day_avg_balance,
  COUNT(e.end_of_day_balance) AS days_in_window
FROM
  customer_daily_eod_balance d
JOIN
  customer_daily_eod_balance e
  ON d.customer_id = e.customer_id
     AND DATE(e.date) BETWEEN DATE(d.date, '-29 days') AND DATE(d.date)
GROUP BY
  d.customer_id,
  d.date
HAVING
  COUNT(e.end_of_day_balance) >= 30
)

  month_year,
  SUM(customer_month_max) AS monthly_sum_max_30day_avg_balance
FROM (
  -- per-customer per-month maximum adjusted 30-day rolling average
  SELECT
    r.customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', r.txn_date) AS month_year,
    MAX(CASE WHEN r.rolling_30day_avg_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE r.rolling_30day_avg_balance END) AS customer_month_max
  FROM customer_30day_rolling_avg_balance_67 r

  GROUP BY r.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', r.txn_date)

  -- each customer's baseline month (YYYY-MM) from their earliest transaction date
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(txn_date)) AS baseline_month
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
) b
  ON cm.customer_id = b.customer_id
WHERE cm.month_year <> b.baseline_month
GROUP BY month_year
ORDER BY month_year ASC

rows.question: For each customer, calculate their daily balances for every day between their earliest and latest transaction dates, including days without transactions by carrying forward the previous day's balance. Treat any negative daily balances as zero. Then, for each month, determine the highest daily balance each customer had during that month. Finally, for each month, sum these maximum daily balances across all customers to obtain a monthly total.

WITH customer_transaction_date_summaries AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    date(substr(txn_date, 1, 10)) AS txn_date,
    SUM(txn_amount) AS daily_txn_amount
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, date(substr(txn_date, 1, 10))
),
customer_transaction_date_range_70 AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MIN(date(substr(txn_date,1,10))) AS first_txn_date,
    MAX(date(substr(txn_date,1,10))) AS last_txn_date
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
-- helper numbers table to generate ranges
nums AS (
  SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9
),
nums10 AS (
  SELECT a.n + 10*b.n AS n FROM nums a CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4) b
),
nums100 AS (
  SELECT a.n + 100*b.n AS n FROM nums10 a CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2) b
),
numbers AS (
  SELECT n FROM nums100
),
-- per-customer expanded calendar
customer_cal AS (
  SELECT
    r.customer_id,
    date(r.first_txn_date, '+' || numbers.n || ' days') AS calendar_date
  FROM customer_transaction_date_range_70 r
  JOIN numbers ON date(r.first_txn_date, '+' || numbers.n || ' days') <= r.last_txn_date
),
-- per-customer per-day amounts (0 if none)
customer_daily AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.calendar_date AS txn_date,
    COALESCE(s.daily_txn_amount, 0) AS daily_txn_amount
  FROM customer_cal c
  LEFT JOIN customer_transaction_date_summaries s
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id AND s.txn_date = c.calendar_date
),
-- cumulative balance per customer/day (can be negative, will be floored later)
customer_daily_cum AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    SUM(daily_txn_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date
                                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_balance_raw
  FROM customer_daily
),
-- per customer-month maximum daily balance (with negatives treated as zero)
customer_month_max AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS calendar_year,
    CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS month_number,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cum_balance_raw < 0 THEN 0 ELSE cum_balance_raw END) AS customer_month_max_balance
  FROM customer_daily_cum
  GROUP BY customer_id, calendar_year, month_number
)
-- final monthly sum across customers
SELECT
  calendar_year,
  month_number,
  SUM(customer_month_max_balance) AS monthly_total_max_daily_balance
FROM customer_month_max
GROUP BY calendar_year, month_number
ORDER BY calendar_year, month_number

        FROM ball_by_ball lag_pair
        WHERE lag_pair.match_id = b.match_id
          AND lag_pair.innings_no = b.innings_no

  COALESCE(

WITH wickets_with_kind_and_player AS (
SELECT
  w.match_id,

LEFT JOIN player bowler_player ON b.bowler = bowler_player.player_id

),

  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.bowler,
  b.team_bowling,
  b.team_batting,
  b.striker,
  b.non_striker
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN extra_runs e
  ON e.match_id = b.match_id
  AND e.over_id = b.over_id

wickets_attributed_to_bowler AS (

  w.ball_id,

  w.player_out,

  b.bowler

SELECT
  p.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  COALESCE(w.total_wickets, 0) AS total_wickets,
  CASE WHEN ld.total_balls > 0 THEN (ld.total_runs_conceded * 1.0 / ld.total_balls) * 6 ELSE NULL END AS economy_rate,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(w.total_wickets,0) > 0 THEN ld.total_balls * 1.0 / w.total_wickets ELSE NULL END AS strike_rate_balls_per_wicket,
  bm.best_match_figures AS best_match_figures
FROM player p
JOIN (
  -- total balls and runs conceded per bowler across all matches (only legal deliveries)
  SELECT
    ld.bowler AS player_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_balls,

  FROM legal_deliveries ld
  LEFT JOIN runs_off_bat_by_ball rob
    ON rob.match_id = ld.match_id
   AND rob.over_id = ld.over_id
   AND rob.ball_id = ld.ball_id
   AND rob.innings_no = ld.innings_no
  GROUP BY ld.bowler
) ld ON ld.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN (
  -- total wickets attributed to bowler across all matches
  SELECT
    wab.bowler AS player_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_wickets
  FROM wickets_attributed_to_bowler wab
  JOIN legal_deliveries ld2
    ON ld2.match_id = wab.match_id
   AND ld2.over_id = wab.over_id
   AND ld2.ball_id = wab.ball_id
   AND ld2.innings_no = wab.innings_no
   AND ld2.bowler = wab.bowler
  GROUP BY wab.bowler
) w ON w.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN (
  -- best match figures per bowler: choose match with max wickets, tiebreaker min runs
  SELECT
    bm.bowler AS player_id,
    (bm.match_wickets || '-' || bm.match_runs) AS best_match_figures
  FROM (
    SELECT
      m.bowler,
      m.match_id,
      m.match_wickets,
      m.match_runs,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY m.bowler
        ORDER BY m.match_wickets DESC, m.match_runs ASC
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      -- per match per bowler wickets and runs (only legal deliveries)
      SELECT
        ld.bowler,
        ld.match_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wab.match_id || '|' || wab.over_id || '|' || wab.ball_id || '|' || wab.innings_no) AS match_wickets,
        SUM(COALESCE(rob.runs_off_bat,0)) AS match_runs
      FROM legal_deliveries ld
      LEFT JOIN runs_off_bat_by_ball rob
        ON rob.match_id = ld.match_id
       AND rob.over_id = ld.over_id
       AND rob.ball_id = ld.ball_id
       AND rob.innings_no = ld.innings_no
      LEFT JOIN wickets_attributed_to_bowler wab
        ON wab.match_id = ld.match_id
       AND wab.over_id = ld.over_id
       AND wab.ball_id = ld.ball_id
       AND wab.innings_no = ld.innings_no
       AND wab.bowler = ld.bowler
      GROUP BY ld.bowler, ld.match_id
    ) m
  ) bm
  WHERE bm.rn = 1
) bm ON bm.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE ld.total_balls > 0
